name: Summit AZ - Mesa Plumber Page Plan 2026-09-14
body:
> Plan · Summit Az · 2026-09-14

# Summary
Plan to win "plumber mesa az" by rebuilding the existing Mesa page rather than creating a new one. Three files: `Summit-AZ-Mesa-Keyword-Map-2026-09-14.md` (cannibalization review), `Summit-AZ-Mesa-Page-Draft-2026-09-14.md` (full page draft) and `Summit-AZ-Mesa-FAQ-Page-New-Questions-2026-09-14.md` (Q&As for 8 empty sections of /plumbing-faqs-for-mesa-homeowners/).

# Key findings (keyword map)
- Do not create a new Mesa page. /general-plumbing-services-in-mesa/ (page 8574) exists; a new page would make three pages chase the same search (homepage, Mesa page, /plumbing/).
- GSC Jun 15 to Sep 13: every general "plumber mesa" search went to the homepage at about position 50; 0 clicks from 128 Mesa plumbing queries. "licensed plumber in mesa az" 371 impressions at 71.
- Real demand for the cluster is about 2,400 to 2,800 a month (Search Atlas pools the variants), CPC about $90. "mesa plumbing" is partly another company's brand.
- Live SERP: Mesa-based firms rank with homepages; Valley-wide firms rank with a dedicated Mesa page.

# The draft
- Rebuild page 8574 in place for "plumber Mesa AZ" (residential and rental only, URL kept). Title "Plumber Mesa AZ | Summit Plumbing Pros | Free Estimates" (55); full keyword-to-page map so emergency, brand and commercial terms go elsewhere or nowhere.
- /plumbing/ H1 was moved to Phoenix Valley wording (live Sep 14) to remove one competitor page.

# Mesa FAQ page additions
- New answers on slab leak signs, finding leaks without breaking floors, gurgling drains, sewer line responsibility in Mesa, chemical drain cleaners, water heater noises and relief valves, hard water signs and Mesa's water sources. No prices or business claims; City of Mesa and NWS sources; 5 blog links.

# Decisions and status
- Not live as of Oct 1. The new title and focus keyword wait on Scott's homepage decision, plus 5 Kim confirmations.
- Kim kept the homepage H1 on Oct 21 ("Phoenix Valley's Trusted Plumbers..."); the homepage still holds "plumber mesa az" in Rank Math.
